title: The waiting page shows what differs between options, opens the exact state, and takes combined answers
why: Review-page standard from an outside page you shared, Oct 27 02:23 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2DrFwwCVeSEX2GFLj7CxtiZ); the c100 lane left items 2, 3 and 5 out of scope.
note: Build in skills/waiting-page: (2) a coloured edge marks what differs between options; (3) "open this state in the full mockup" deep-links to a named state; (5) combined answers such as "A+B" where options can coexist. Items 1, 4 and 6 landed with c100. Ruling, Oct 27 02:27 CDT (shiv, decision card cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2XJphRcvzru8mtAcr3kFpGu): a question that changes no rule carries stands: true and sits in a last "Pick stands" section; one that touches a rule starts blank (on main per SKILL.md). From c74 (ruled Oct 26, shiv): keep "Accept every pick", and before it saves, list every pick it will save; built or not is unchecked. Small defects from the c100 review: undoSend's bar repeats "and"; a failed Undo names only one item; a failed receipt delete can leave an old receipt; empty tiers are hidden, not "Nothing here right now". Built in the c126/d9 lane instead (your asks Oct 27 11:40 CDT): Clear removed (a second click unselects; an empty Change draft sends as "Withdraw answer"), and a note with no pick sends as a "none" answer. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs everywhere. Placed after c104 (triage, Oct 27): the same page, after the final look. Same lane, from your review of degen's page (Oct 27 11:47 CDT, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2WX6jeX97e4YdP1xjEqUvnJ): each option's picture sits inside its own option card and a tap on it picks the option; a picture is fitted whole, never cropped; the option-key chip stays on one line and never overlaps the title. Same lane, from banchi's page (Oct 27 11:56 CDT, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2ByQ3cy16LrifwTudkSyi83): the option chip shows the letter A, B, C, never a long key; "Take my pick" and "Ready to send" name the option's title, not its key; the count digit in "0 of 9 sent" matches its line; the left list gives each item a short title or tooltip. Same lane: the gold star on the pick box becomes the AI sparkle icon, inline SVG (Oct 27 11:56 CDT, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2MYnDNTawHFW2QEBty1eAzw).
